name: Draft safe email replies from webhooks with Groq and Guardrails

parameters.content:
# Draft safe email replies from webhooks with Groq and Guardrails

An AI assistant that reads email will follow instructions hidden inside it, because the model cannot tell your rules apart from text in the message. This workflow limits what the assistant can do, in code, instead of trusting it to resist.

### Who's it for
Teams letting an AI draft replies to customer email, helpdesk tickets or form messages, who need to be sure it can never send data to the wrong place.

### How it works
1. Rebuilds the text a person would actually see and scores the message on anything hidden.
2. Replaces card numbers, IBANs and API keys before the model reads anything.
3. Stops high-risk messages before they reach the model.
4. Drafts a reply from your facts only. The recipient is set in code, never by the model.
5. Checks every reply in code for stray addresses, unapproved links, card or key shaped text, and length.
6. Holds anything that fails, with the reason, and reports the whole run.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Add a Groq credential to **POST Writing to LLM** (the free tier is enough)
- [ ] Fill `about_us` in **Set Email Fields** with the facts the assistant may use
- [ ] Set `allowed_recipient_domains` and `allowed_links` to your own
- [ ] Point `action_url` at your sending endpoint, or replace **POST Final Reply** with a Gmail, Outlook or Slack node
- [ ] Send a test message to the webhook with `dry_run` on, read the report, then turn it off

### Customization
Lower `high_risk_at` to hold more messages. Edit the numbered rules in **Compose Writing Request** to change tone or language. **Validate Generated Reply** is plain code, so you can add your own checks beside the ones there.

## Receive and normalize input

Accepts inbound content, applies workflow settings, and converts the incoming payload into a consistent structure for later processing.

## Extract and redact message

Keeps only the content a human would see, strips secrets before model exposure, and reconstructs a safe message package.

## Safety gate and stop

Checks whether the cleaned message is safe enough to answer and records an early-stop outcome when it should not proceed to AI drafting.

## Draft and validate reply

Builds the Groq writing request, calls the LLM to generate a draft reply, and checks the reply before it can leave the workflow.

## Merge and decide action

Combines the successful draft path with the early-stop path, evaluates each outcome, and determines whether there is anything eligible to send.

## Send approved reply

Posts the approved reply to the configured action endpoint and captures the result of that send attempt.

## Collect and report results

Merges sent, dry-run and held outcomes so every message appears in one final report.

assignments.name: about_us
assignments.value: Replace this with the facts your assistant may rely on. For example: Standard delivery is 3 working days. Minimum order is 50 GBP. We are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. We never take card details by email.
